rationale: The position is only one minute old and price remains above both the 9-EMA ($6.96) and the original invalidation level ($6.94), with no new adverse news or structural breakdown — the entry thesis is still intact. The ATR is extremely tight ($0.02) limiting upside, but price has not yet triggered any reason to exit; with 201 minutes remaining and the stop clearly defined, allowing the trade its minimum viable time to develop is mechanically appropriate. No evidence has emerged to justify the double-commission cost of a flip, nor a clean cause to close.
